title: Curb cuts

blocks.html: The City Planning Commission may authorize, subject to the applicable zoning district regulations, curb cuts located on a wide street, provided the Commission finds that a curb cut at such a location:
blocks.plainText: The City Planning Commission may authorize, subject to the applicable zoning district regulations, curb cuts located on a wide street, provided the Commission finds that a curb cut at such a location:

blocks.html: (a)        is not hazardous to traffic safety;
blocks.plainText: (a) is not hazardous to traffic safety;

blocks.html: (b)        will not create or contribute to serious traffic congestion, or unduly inhibit vehicular movement;
blocks.plainText: (b) will not create or contribute to serious traffic congestion, or unduly inhibit vehicular movement;

blocks.html: (c)        will not adversely affect pedestrian movement;
blocks.plainText: (c) will not adversely affect pedestrian movement;

blocks.html: (d)        will not interfere with the efficient functioning of bus lanes, specially designated streets or public transit facilities; and
blocks.plainText: (d) will not interfere with the efficient functioning of bus lanes, specially designated streets or public transit facilities; and

blocks.html: (e)        will not be inconsistent with the character of the existing streetscape.
blocks.plainText: (e) will not be inconsistent with the character of the existing streetscape.

blocks.html: The Commission may prescribe appropriate conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse effects on the character of the surrounding area.
blocks.plainText: The Commission may prescribe appropriate conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse effects on the character of the surrounding area.
